nextStoryContext: US-002 wires commitExistsForStory from host.ts + loop.ts using anchored git detection (e.g. git log --grep on the story id, subject validated with commitSubjectMatchesStory exported from src/supervisor/result.ts). The new WorkerOutcomeKind 'no-commit' is returned by readWorkerOutcome when a passes:true story (not requires:'operator') fails the gate; loop.ts does NOT yet special-case 'no-commit' (it falls through the existing if-blocks with no notify and just `continue`s to the next iteration, since none of the current kind checks in loop.ts match it) -- US-002's own acceptance criteria define what the loop should actually do with it (the hint in this story said 're-dispatch/no-progress' treatment, similar to the CAM-36 no-progress guard). commitExistsForStory is optional so all pre-existing callers (host.ts, tests) are unaffected until US-002 wires it. Two gate sites in result.ts both call the shared confirmCommitGate/isOperatorStory helpers.
